fields.name: Hydrating Facial Cleanser
fields.description: A gentle facial cleanser designed to remove dirt, excess oil, and everyday impurities.

fields.name: Lattafa Yara Pink Eau de Parfum
fields.description: A sweet, feminine fragrance with creamy vanilla, soft florals and fruity notes. Perfect for everyday wear, dates and special occasions.

fields.name: Lattafa Khamrah Eau de Parfum
fields.description: A warm, inviting fragrance with sweet gourmand accords, cinnamon, dates, and vanilla. Ideal for evening outings, cooler weather, and anyone who enjoys rich, long-lasting scents.

fields.name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum
fields.description: A bold, glamorous fragrance blending sweet notes with rich florals and warm tonka bean. Designed for those who love an elegant scent that makes a statement.

fields.name: Lattafa Fakhar Rose Eau de Parfum
fields.description: An elegant feminine fragrance with floral accords and a soft, sophisticated finish. Suitable for daily wear, office days, celebrations and romantic evenings.

fields.name: CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser
fields.description: A gentle foaming facial cleanser designed to remove excess oil, dirt and impurities without leaving the skin feeling stripped. Ideal for normal to oily skin.

fields.name: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Serum
fields.description: : A lightweight facial serum formulated with niacinamide and zinc to help improve the appearance of uneven skin tone, visible pores and excess oil. Suitable for a simple daily skincare routine.

fields.name: NIVEA Sun UV Face Shine Control SPF 50
fields.description: A facial sunscreen designed to provide high sun protection while helping reduce unwanted shine. A useful addition to a daily skincare routine, especially for people who prefer a matte finish.

fields.name: Garnier Vitamin C Brightening Serum
fields.description: : A lightweight vitamin C serum designed to brighten the appearance of dull skin and improve the look of uneven skin tone. Apply as directed and use sunscreen during the day.

fields.name: Maybelline Lifter Gloss
fields.description: A glossy lip product that gives lips a smooth, luminous finish. Perfect for everyday wear, soft glam looks, and adding shine over lipstick or wearing alone.

fields.name: L.A. Girl Pro Conceal HD Concealer
fields.description: A creamy concealer designed to help cover the appearance of blemishes and dark circles while creating a more even-looking complexion. Suitable for everyday makeup and full-glam looks.

fields.name: Maybelline Lash Sensational Mascara
fields.description: A mascara designed to define and separate lashes while adding volume for a fuller-looking effect. Ideal for enhancing the eyes in both natural and dramatic makeup looks.

fields.name: Maybelline Fit Me Matte + Poreless Foundation
fields.description: A lightweight liquid foundation designed to provide a natural matte finish while helping minimize the appearance of pores. Ideal for everyday makeup and normal to oily skin. Available in different shades to complement various skin tones.

fields.name: Vaseline Intensive Care Cocoa Radiant Body Lotion
fields.description: A moisturizing body lotion formulated with cocoa butter to help soften dry skin and leave it feeling smooth. Ideal for everyday body care

fields.name: NIVEA Cocoa Butter Body Lotion
fields.description: A nourishing body lotion designed to moisturize dry skin while leaving a soft, smooth feel and a pleasant fragrance. Suitable for daily use.

fields.name: Dove Deeply Nourishing Beauty Bar
fields.description: A gentle cleansing beauty bar designed to clean the skin while helping maintain its moisture. A simple addition to an everyday bathing routine.

fields.name: Tree Hut Shea Sugar Scrub
fields.description: An exfoliating body scrub designed to remove dead skin cells and leave the skin feeling smoother and softer. Use gently as directed for a refreshing body-care routine.

fields.name: Cantu Shea Butter Leave-In Conditioning Repair Cream
fields.description: A leave-in conditioning cream designed to moisturize hair, improve manageability and help reduce breakage associated with styling. Suitable for textured, curly and natural hair routines.

fields.name: Motions Daily Moisturizing Hair Lotion
fields.description: A moisturizing hair lotion designed to soften hair, improve manageability and help reduce dryness. Suitable for everyday hair maintenance and styling.

fields.name: ORS Olive Oil Replenishing Conditioner
fields.description: A conditioning treatment formulated to soften hair and improve manageability. Ideal for hair-care routines focused on moisture and easier detangling.

fields.name: Eco Styler Olive Oil Styling Gel
fields.description: A styling gel designed to provide hold and definition for curls, twists, slick-back styles and other hairstyles. Suitable for creating polished looks.
